t: This 4lite Vinovia LED white downlight is a versatile recessed lighting solution, ideal for various indoor applications. It features a fixed and adjustable 2-in-1 design, offering directional lighting flexibility. With selectable colour temperatures of 3000K, 4000K or 6500K, and dimmable functionality, it adapts to different environments. Its low-profile 35mm depth makes it suitable for shallow ceilings, while the IP44 rating allows for installation in bathroom Zone 2. Pre-wired for quick installation, this 4W downlight provides 480 lumens and a 60,000-hour life, making it a reliable choice for both domestic and commercial projects.
b: 4 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
